1. Cumulative mining panel, by district

Same definition as build_03_embedding_panel.R / explore_mining_vs_forest_type_app.js: the union-to-date of mine_mask_ghana_c4_<yr> (monotonically non-decreasing cumulative footprint), not each year’s raw independent classification. Built, pulled by district, and written to outputs/tables/mining_by_district.csv / mining_by_region.csv by diag_05_data_prep.R – see that script for the EE/rgee side of this.

2. National total (sanity check)

District-level sum should match a direct national reduceRegion closely (small differences are scale/edge-pixel rounding, not a bug).

Code 
read_csv(here(tbl_dir, "national_check.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  kable(digits = 1, caption = paste0("National cumulative mining through ", latest_year))
National cumulative mining through 2025
method km2
sum of districts 2429.7
direct national reduceRegion 2269.1

5. Region overview: level + growth together

Each bar’s grey segment is the 2020 level, the coloured segment is growth to 2025, so bar length = current total and the split shows how much of that total is pre-existing vs. new.

Code 
knitr::include_graphics(here(fig_dir, "fig_region_overview_combined.png"))

8. Mining encroachment on protected areas, 2025

How much of each district’s cumulative gold mining footprint falls inside a WDPA/WDOECM Designated protected area (national parks, forest reserves, etc. – “Proposed” sites excluded, not yet legally protected).

Code 
pa_summary <- read_csv(here(tbl_dir, "national_pa_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cat(sprintf(
  "National: %.1f km2 (%.1f%%) of cumulative gold mining through %d falls inside a Designated protected area.\n",
  pa_summary$nat_mining_in_pa, pa_summary$pct_mining_in_pa, pa_summary$year))

National: 121.7 km2 (5.0%) of cumulative gold mining through 2025 falls inside a Designated protected area.

Code 
read_csv(here(tbl_dir, "protected_overlap_top15.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
